evidence_items.locator: Historical revenue paragraph; preceding paragraph on profitability since inception
evidence_items.explanation: This Reuters-based account reports substantial realized revenue and separately describes Surge as profitable since inception. It is a relevant exception and evidence of commercial demand, but gives no net-income amount or accounting definition; it cannot disprove a majority claim.

unresolved_gaps: No exhaustive or representative population with comparable net-income results was established.
The evidence does not establish profitability status for enough of the named companies to determine a majority.
Reported profitable exceptions do not consistently specify accounting definitions.
The product-market-fit language supplies neither a duration nor a measurable threshold.
No valuation standard is supplied, and the qualified judgment cannot fairly be converted into a firm numerical assertion.
